shots.scene: In a dark studio apartment a phone lights up on the nightstand while its owner sleeps.
shots.setting: a small studio apartment at 3 a.m. with a tall window over a foggy city

characters.action: sleeps curled under a thick blanket

props: narrow bed with a rumpled blanket
tall window with distant city lights
stack of books on the floor
caption: 새벽 세 시,
휴대폰만 홀로 깨어 있습니다…
poses: The stocky man in the plum hoodie lifts his head from the pillow and squints toward the glowing phone.
The stocky man in the plum hoodie pushes himself up on one elbow and grabs the glowing phone.
The stocky man in the plum hoodie sits on the edge of the bed, holding the glowing phone close to his face.

shots.scene: Close on hands typing fast on a laptop at a kitchen table under a single hanging lamp.
shots.setting: a cramped kitchen table late at night

characters.action: types quickly on the laptop keys

props: open laptop with a glowing screen
caption: 식은 커피 옆에서
손가락만 바쁘게 움직이고
poses: The hands stop typing; one hand lifts off the keys and wraps around the red coffee mug.

shots.scene: At sunrise on neighboring apartment balconies, the tired engineer steps out while an early-rising neighbor tends plants.
shots.setting: two narrow balconies side by side above a hazy city at dawn

characters.action: leans on the railing holding a pale coffee mug
waters potted plants on the next balcony

caption: 해가 뜰 무렵, 도시는
아무 일 없던 얼굴입니다
poses: The stocky man in the plum hoodie sets the mug on the railing and starts to raise his arms.
The stocky man in the plum hoodie stretches both arms high while the tall old woman looks over at him.
The tall old woman in the grey-green vest waves at the stretching man, who waves back with one hand.
